comparison_notes: Seeds vary paired projection initialization and minibatch order; both are identical across arms within a seed.
All active arms have 11*features+2 trainable parameters. Effective feature rank, expressivity and compute are not equalized.
Tanh acts on the same anchor-linearized feature displacement, not a learned unconstrained MLP or the full geometric map.
The local anchor and Jacobian agree, but feature distributions and gradient conditioning away from the anchor are not equalized.
Evaluation blocks were previously inspected in the WaveGate study. This is a reused exploratory benchmark, not a pristine held-out confirmation.
These arms share the preceding WaveGate study's update budget but use 8450 rather than 1536/1537 parameters; cross-family differences are not a parameter-matched victory.
